messages:
D1 際 - 塀: edge/verge/side boundary sense versus boundary wall
D2 限 - 塀: limit/boundary sense versus boundary wall
D3 門 - 塀: gate as a boundary structure versus boundary wall; fence
D4 城 - 塀: castle walls/fortification versus boundary wall
D5 節 - 拍: musical melody/measure/rhythm secondary sense versus musical beat
D6 歌 - 拍: song/music domain versus musical beat
D7 鳴 - 拍: ring/sound (striking a bell or drum) versus clap
D8 響 - 拍: resound/sound versus clap; musical beat
D9 討 - 拍: attack/strike (討つ うつ) versus clap/strike
D10 拝 - 拍: worship with ritual hand-clapping at a shrine versus clap
D11 度 - 拍: counter for occurrences/times versus beat as a counted unit
D12 符 - 拍: sign/mark/musical note versus marking senses in the 打つ/拍つ family
D13 用 - 耗: use versus wear down through use
D14 磨 - 耗: polish/grind (磨耗 wear) versus wear down
D15 削 - 耗: pare/reduce versus decrease
D16 疲 - 耗: grow tired/exhaustion versus wear down; exhaustion in 消耗
D17 乏 - 耗: scarce/lacking versus depletion
D18 欠 - 耗: lack/gap versus depletion; decrease
D19 枯 - 耗: wither/dry up (depletion) versus decrease; wear down
D20 着 - 耗: wear (shared English head word) versus wear down through use
D21 絶 - 耗: sever/cease/die out versus being used up
D22 劣 - 耗: inferior/worse (deterioration) versus wear down
E1 摩 - exclusion target of 拍; rub/chafe text needed to judge the undeclared 耗/摩 pair (摩耗 wear)
E2 擦 - exclusion target of 拍; scrape/rub text needed to judge the undeclared 耗/擦 pair
E3 断 - exclusion target of 耗; its senses needed to judge consistency with undeclared 絶
E4 使 - exclusion target of 耗; its use senses needed to judge consistency with undeclared 用
E5 曲 - exclusion target of 拍; its music senses needed to judge consistency with undeclared 歌 and 節
E6 辺 - exclusion target of 塀; its edge/boundary senses needed to judge consistency with undeclared 際
